让升力绕着主轴做功: Turns aerodynamic lift into shaft work
三片叶片扫过直径 126 米的圆。截面、弦长与扭转沿 NREL 参照叶片的 19: Three blades sweep a 126-metre circle. Airfoil sections, chord and twist follow 19 stations of the NREL reference blade. Their lift and drag polars determine the aerodynamic loads. Farther out, rotation adds more relative wind speed, so the blade becomes narrower and less twisted.
转动整片叶片，改变迎角: Rotates each blade to change its angle of attack
叶片能绕自己的长轴转动。风速高时，控制器把叶片转向顺风，减少升力做功。这里用叶素: Each blade rotates about its own span. In stronger wind the controller feathers it to reduce aerodynamic work. A BEM-derived feed-forward pitch is combined with speed feedback, with an 8°/s actuator limit. This is our teaching controller, not OpenFAST’s original controller.
以很低的转速传递很大的扭矩: Carries large torque at low rotational speed
额定叶轮只每分钟转 12.1 圈，却要传递兆瓦级功率。功率等于扭矩乘角速度，所以: At rated speed the rotor makes only 12.1 revolutions per minute while transmitting megawatts. Power equals torque times angular velocity, so the slow shaft carries large torque. This model reflects total inertia to the low-speed shaft; aerodynamic, generator and brake torque determine acceleration.
本作品设计了两级固定齿圈的行星轮系，传动比分别为 1+72/18=5 和 1+9: Two original fixed-ring planetary stages give ratios 1+72/18=5 and 1+96/24=5. A final 97:25 external mesh makes 5×5×97/25=97. Planets orbit and spin simultaneously. The overall ratio is from NREL; stage tooth counts and layout are our teaching design.
把轴功率送进电路: Transfers shaft power to the electrical circuit
转子转动时，磁场扫过三组相差 120° 的线圈。教学电路选择三对磁极，电频率为转: The rotor field passes three winding groups separated by 120°. Our teaching circuit chooses three pole pairs, so electrical frequency is rpm×3/60. Electrical output is 94.4% of mechanical input; the rest is counted as loss. Poles and coils are schematic, not the reference generator’s engineering design.
顺桨减少风力，再把转动能变成热: Feather first, then dissipate rotational energy
顺桨是主要的气动减速方式。机械盘式制动在高速轴上施加扭矩，经齿轮比折算到低速轴。: Feathering provides aerodynamic slowing. A mechanical disc brake applies torque on the fast shaft, reflected through the gearbox to the rotor. Braking does not stop the blades instantly; its dissipation and falling rotational energy appear in the ledger. Cut-out wind or overspeed latches a shutdown.
让整个机舱转向来风: Turns the entire nacelle toward the wind
风向标给出方向，塔顶的齿圈与电机慢慢转动机舱。这里的偏航速度限制为每秒 0.3°: The vane supplies direction while tower-top motors and a ring gear slowly turn the nacelle. Yaw is limited to 0.3°/s, so realignment after a wind shift takes time. Misalignment uses normal inflow only, without a full yawed-wake solution.
把随转速改变的电，接入固定频率的电网: Connects variable-frequency generation to the grid
转子的转速在变，电网频率却需要稳定。教学链路将三相交流整流成直流，再逆变到 50: Rotor speed varies while grid frequency must remain fixed. Our teaching chain rectifies three-phase AC to DC, inverts to 50 or 60 Hz, then steps up voltage. Converter and transformer are ideal and lossless. The 690 V, 33 kV and three pole pairs are display assumptions, not NREL electrical specifications.
交流 → 直流 → 电网交流 · 理想变流: AC → DC → grid AC · Ideal conversion
把叶轮托进更高处的风里: Raises the rotor into the wind
轮毂高度为 90 米；塔底直径 6 米，塔顶 3.87 米。电缆沿塔筒向下连接变: Hub height is 90 metres; tower diameter tapers from 6 to 3.87 metres. Cables run down to the transformer. Tower, nacelle and foundation details are original geometry and remain rigid; structural strength, vibration, waves and geotechnics are not analyzed.

手动变桨可让叶片顺风，也可让叶轮失速；安全停机会优先顺桨。: Manual pitch can feather or stall the rotor. Safety shutdown overrides it to feather.
负载改变反扭矩。减小负载会先让叶轮加速，自动变桨随后限速。: Load changes opposing torque. Reducing it initially accelerates the rotor; automatic pitch then regulates speed.
三对磁极与全功率变流器为教学电路；不复现真实机组的电磁设计。: Three pole pairs and a full converter form a teaching circuit, not a replica of the reference machine’s electromagnetic design.
叶片沿途都不一样: A blade changes along its span
从根部到叶尖，气流的方向和速度都在变。拖动位置，比较同一片叶片上的弦长、扭转与迎: Relative flow speed and direction vary from root to tip. Move along the blade to compare chord, twist and angle of attack.
